components: Submitted jobs and schedules become durable before acknowledgment.
Due jobs with satisfied dependencies become runnable.
Runnable tasks are matched to workers with available resources.
Workers claim, execute, and periodically persist progress.
Expired assignments return to the runnable set for safe retry.
